description: Prepare opening an LP vault, for a wallet the LP registry lets open one (a curator it allows, or anyone once it opens vault creation): its name, performance fee (500 to 1,500 bps of each loan's fixed cost, fixed for good), largest loan and the pools it funds (gage_capabilities lpLane.pools). A wallet the LP registry lets open one (a curator it allows, or anyone once it opens vault creation) opens a vault through the lane's factory and curates it: it funds loans only in the pools of its mandate, a pool added funding three hours later and one dropped stopping at once (open loans run on); the curator never touches its lenders' money. Returns the next unsigned transaction; never signs.

maxLoanPrincipal.description: The largest loan the vault funds, raw USDG (6 decimals), at most 10,000,000 USDG; you may change it later

name.description: The vault's name, as depositors see it (at most 64 bytes)

performanceFeeBps.description: Your share of each loan's fixed cost, in bps: 500 to 1,500 (5% to 15%); fixed for good

pools.description: The pools the vault funds loans in (its mandate), each once: from gage_capabilities lpLane.pools

pool.description: The pool, as gage_capabilities lpLane.pools names it under that adapter

name: gage_prepare_lp_create_vault
title: Prepare: Open an LP vault
